The Board of Directors at its meeting held today, i.e., Thursday, 29th October 2026, has, interalia, 
approved the following: 
(a) Audited standalone and unaudited consolidated financial results of the Company for the 
quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026; and 
(b) Payment of interim dividend of Rs. 5.75 (Rupees five and paise seventy-five only) per equity
